messages:
kai: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: routing/gating errors caused multiple short outages. We need a compact playbook update + owners. Keep this thread tight.

mira: I'll take the playbook edits (triage steps + decision tree). Plan: add a clear "stop rollout" checklist and rollback commands. ETA 2024-11-07. Owner: @mira.

dev: I'll add CLI snippets for diagnostics and safe revert. Sample:```
# list current rollouts
redwoodctl rollout status --env=prod --route=llm-chat
# stop current rollout and pin to previous variant
redwoodctl rollout abort --id=$ROLLID --reason "auto-revert from playbook"
# collect per-variant metrics
redwoodctl metrics variant --route=llm-chat --window=5m
```

noor: Add escalation rule: if p99 increases > 40% OR error-rate doubles within 10m after a gate -> immediate abort + page SRE lead. I'll own the escalation section. Due 2024-11-05.

sam: Observed pattern: most regressions are after manual weight bumps > 20%. Recommend policy: any weight change > 15% requires canary + SRE approval. I'll draft the policy. Owner: @sam. ETA 2024-11-01.

kai: Good. Can we include an oncall quick mitigation: temporarily set routing to fallback variant and pause deployments? Example command?

dev: Add this under "Immediate Actions":```
# force traffic to fallback variant immediately
redwoodctl routing set --route=llm-chat --variant=fallback --force --note "emergency set by oncall"
# pause automated rollouts
redwoodctl rollout pause --service=router
```

mira: Will include that. Also adding a short checklist for oncall: collect metrics, dump rollout state, notify product, execute mitigation.

noor: For alerts, draft rule: "RouteRolloutBreach" that checks p99 and error-rate with a 5m window and a 3m for condition hold. I'll paste YAML in the doc.

sam: I'll also add a small audit requirement: routing changes >15% must include a brief rationale in PR and a link to a canary plan.

kai: Let's create tickets and owners here so we can track closure.

dev: Proposed tickets:
- RW-INC-4890: playbook update (triage + stop criteria) - owner: mira - due 2024-11-07
- RW-INC-4891: diag commands & mitigation snippets - owner: dev - due 2024-11-03
- RW-INC-4892: gating enforcement + auto-abort hook - owner: noor - due 2024-11-05
- RW-INC-4893: routing change policy & PR checklist - owner: sam - due 2024-11-01

ops-bot: Reminder: add two approvers (SRE + Routing) on playbook PRs. I will ping owners 72h before due dates.

mira: Reviewers: @dev (routing) and @noor (sre). I'll tag them on the PR.

sam: Also propose a 60/30/10 rollout schedule for large changes with gates at each step and automated validation. I'll write that in the policy doc.

kai: Add a short reproduction snippet in the postmortem (client payload shape + traffic spike pattern) so product/ML can follow up.

dev: I'll add a small dashboard tile for "rollout-health" showing p50/p95/p99 per variant and error-rate. Owner: dev.

noor: Let's also schedule a review cadence: weekly for first month after rollout, then monthly for two months. I'll add calendar invites.

mira: PR draft: https://git.internal.redwood.com/r/playbooks/pulls/224 (draft)

dev: I'll post the CLI snippets in a gist and link the playbook.

ops-bot: Thread archived after 72h of inactivity. Reminders scheduled.

kai: Thanks team — I'll update the postmortem doc with ticket links once Jira items exist. If anything shifts, reply here.
